company.name: Lendsnap
company.shortDescription: Lendsnap operates an online platform to find and share mortgage documents.
company.description: Lendsnap transforms how lenders find and serve borrowers. They give mortgage lenders a borrower concierge to automate gathering and sharing qualifying documents. They automate loan documentation by linking borrower financial accounts to collect original documents such as bank statements, W2's, tax returns, and pay stubs.
